availability.note: Mazda AU model page lists GT and Azami grades with orders open (GT priced from $56,990 drive-away); Build & Price page https://www.mazda.com.au/build/cx-6e/ exists but renders no data to automated fetches. Two-grade count confirmed by CarExpert and Chasing Cars launch reviews (Oct 2026).

listPrice.note: Mazda AU release (8/4/2026) pricing table, MLP (manufacturer list price) column, GT RWD 190kW/78kWh. CarExpert quick drive (6 Oct 2026) and Chasing Cars repeat it 'before on-road costs' in words; RACV says 'plus ORCs'. Victorian drive-away computed by calc/onroad.js = $57,138; the GT's advertised $56,990 drive-away (Mazda AU page, offer to 31 Dec 2026 per zecar) is below that, so it is a discounted campaign, not the list price.

batteryKwh.note: usable 77.0 kWh; nominal 78.0 kWh on the same page (Mazda AU quotes 78kWh). Same LFP pack as mazda-6e (77 usable).

rangeKm.note: RACV: WLTP up to 484km on 19-inch wheels (the GT's standard size). Mazda AU model page and release also quote 484km WLTP; no separate AU-certified figure found. Chasing Cars quotes 483km.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: RACV: WLTP 18.9kWh/100km on 19-inch wheels; ev-database WLTP 304 Wh/mi (18.9 kWh/100km) for the TEL, stated to include charging losses, matching the dataset's WLTP-label convention. 77/484x100 = 15.9, 19% below; inside the 25% cross-check.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: To the cargo cover (RACV, CarExpert), matching the mazda-6e convention by owner decision 2026-11-26. Mazda AU quotes 468L to the ceiling. Excludes 83L frunk.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Seats folded to the belt line (RACV, CarExpert), same convention as seats-up. Mazda AU quotes 1,434L to the roof.

seats.note: 5 seats; RACV also describes it as a five-seater

towKg.note: Mazda AU: braked towing up to 1,500kg with Mazda Genuine Towing kit, 75kg ball weight; CarExpert quick drive also 1500kg braked

warrantyYears.note: 5 years / unlimited km vehicle warranty, unconditional; HV battery 8 years / 160,000km (also CarsGuide)

insuranceAnnual.note: anchored between mazda-6e-gt ($1,750 at $49,990) and deepal-s07-rwd ($2,200 at $53,900) / tesla-model-y-premium-rwd ($2,300 at $58,900); Mazda's mainstream dealer and repair network kept it under the Deepal and Tesla.

depreciationCurve.note: matches Mazda brand convention set on mazda-6e (same platform, China-built, new EV nameplate with no AU resale history); supported by Mazda moving the GT to a discounted $56,990 drive-away offer within weeks of launch. Slightly gentler than deepal-s07 [1,0.68,...], in line with tesla-model-y [1,0.73,...].
